titre: Synthesis Test n°2 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
My uncle Nabil is a farmer. He lives in a village near Kairouan. Every morning, he gets up at five o'clock. He feeds the animals and works in the fields. He grows tomatoes, olives and wheat. His son Omar helps him after school. At the moment, Nabil is picking olives and Omar is carrying a basket. They are very happy because the harvest is good this year.

Answer:
1) What is Nabil's job? (1 pt)
2) Where does he live? (1 pt)
3) What does he grow? (1 pt)
4) What is Nabil doing at the moment? (1 pt)

Complete with the present simple or present continuous:
1) Nabil (get up) ...... at five o'clock every day.
2) Look! Omar (carry) ...... a basket now.
3) They (be) ...... happy.
4) At the moment, Nabil (pick) ...... olives.

Match the job with what the person does:
1) farmer    a) teaches pupils
2) teacher   b) grows plants
3) doctor    c) helps sick people

Put the words in the right order:
1) a / is / He / farmer / . 
2) the / works / in / He / fields / . 
3) him / helps / Omar / .

Writing:
Write 4 to 5 sentences about a member of your family and his/her job (name, job, place, what he/she does).

Grammar: spelling rule for he/she/it.
Most verbs: add -s (play -> plays). Verbs ending in -o, -sh, -ch, -ss, -x: add -es. Verbs ending in consonant + y: change y to i and add -es.
Complete:
1) go (he) -> ..........
2) wash (she) -> ..........
3) study (he) -> ..........
